items.name: Lorazepam
items.facts: Updated label for Lorazepam (PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.). Boxed warning: WARNING: RISKS FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH OPIOIDS; ABUSE, MISUSE, AND ADDICTION; and DEPENDENCE AND WITHDRAWAL REACTIONS Concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death. Reserve concomitant prescribing of these drugs for patients for whom alternative treatment options are inadequate. Limit dosages and durations to the minimum required. items.summary: The Lorazepam label from PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was updated, featuring a boxed warning covering risks of concomitant opioid use, abuse, misuse, addiction, dependence, and withdrawal reactions.

items.facts: Updated label for Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate (PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.).
